description:
## Why
Each oracle fixture is two programs, the .fz and a hand translation .oracle.exs; nothing checks they mean the same. Most fixtures are already valid Elixir modulo habits (bare def main, dbg, panic).

## What changes
- fixture-metadata + tests/fixture_matrix.rs: `oracle: self` runs `elixir <fixture> <args>` on the fixture. The stamp hashes the fixture source with its oracle.stamp line removed (one stripping function beside with_oracle_stamp).
- Abort oracle: Elixir exits 1, its stderr contains expected.stderr, its stdout equals expected.txt. fz abort paths compare stdout with expected.txt for oracle fixtures. abort_stderr_goldens_are_in_oracle_output is deleted; abort goldens lose the banner line via ORACLE=regen.
- 434 fixtures (fixtures/ + fixtures2/behavior/) rewritten: bare def/defp/defmacro/@attr blocks wrapped in defmodule Main (+ Main.main() when there is a main), dbg( -> IO.inspect(, panic( -> :erlang.error(, header oracle: self; their .oracle.exs deleted. 35 twins remain, each for a named fz-only feature.
- Unit tests that read converted fixtures by path look up Main-qualified names; two falling pins are lowered (00562 inventory 48->47, stream activations 136->135); diagnostics goldens of 00707/00838 get the moved line.
- .agent/docs/fixtures.md oracle section rewritten.

## Signal
.oracle.exs count 469 -> 35; matrix trial names/counts unchanged; ORACLE=check passes; default run starts Elixir 0 times; no pin or golden rises.
title: An Elixir-form fixture is its own oracle
